messages:
ana_sales: CeruleanBank (regulated payments) opened a questionnaire and asked for a short POC. Must-haves: SAML SSO (IdP-initiated + SP-initiated), SCIM bulk (100k target) with nightly deltas, RBAC with delegated admins and audit trails, domain locking (DNS TXT verification), strict EU data residency, and a Hosted vs Dedicated costing comparison. They want a 72-96h pilot and a one-page SOW. Owners?
rami_se: can do the integration track. Clarify: SCIM pattern = initial full import then nightly delta patch? Also need to know if they require group->role mapping (role-based groups) and whether they expect SCIM to provision service accounts.
nana_sales: yes they noted nightly sync + group mappings; said service accounts will be used for automation. Procurement wants a small pricing range and an estimate for a Dedicated path.
joel_eng: sizing note: for 100k users + 200 TPS burst gen traffic recommend 8xGPU reserved with 1.5x burst headroom. Committed spend range typically ~$80k-$150k/month depending on model family and quantization. Hosted POC is easier for initial validation; 72-96h eval (SSO + 10k SCIM + light gen) is usually ~$1.5k-$2.5k in usage.
joel_eng: perf tips  prefix KV caching and per-tenant batching will keep p95 down; we should offer a quantized variant and a cache warm-up window during the POC.
rami_se: sample SCIM mapping to send: ```json
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"externalId":"employee_id","userName":"email","name":{"givenName":"first_name","familyName":"last_name"},"emails":[{"value":"email","type":"work"}],"roles":["group_names"]}
```
rami_se: we can temporarily raise SCIM rate limits for the pilot (e.g., 2-4x) if they agree to backoff guidance and an observed window. Need to confirm sync window (how long to finish 100k import).
tara_sec: security checklist: ask Cerulean for the completed questionnaire, IdP metadata XML (entityID, ACS URLs, X509 cert), SCIM op scope (create/update/patch/delete), data classification (PII/payment data), retention requirements, required audit log retention and access controls, and whether they mandate HSM. We'll provide SOC2 link, DPA, redacted pen-test, encryption-at-rest details, and KMS/HSM options. Who will upload to their portal?
nana_sales: I'll upload the security pack once Tara drops links. Please also provide a one-paragraph security blurb I can paste.
tara_sec: security blurb: "SOC2 Type II, DPA template available, redacted pen-test report, EU-region tenancy supported, managed KMS by default; HSM integrations available for enterprise. Audit logs retained per plan and can be extended for Dedicated customers."
contracts_bot: DPA workflow initiated; need Cerulean legal POC to proceed.
nana_sales: POC plan (suggested): Day0 exchange metadata + create tenant; Day1 run 10k import & SSO checks; Day2 ramp imports (50k), validate RBAC & delegated admin flows; Day3 full import to target or staged ramp to 100k; Day4 perf smoke (ramp to 200 TPS bursts) + handoff. Can compress if they provide IdP + sample CSV right away.
joel_eng: domain locking: we require DNS TXT proof for domain control; we can also validate via CNAME on request. Verification takes ~1-2h after record is live. We'll provide TXT value.
rami_se: I'll prepare SP metadata and a staged import script.
nana_sales: pricing paragraph (draft) to send procurement: "Hosted: pay-as-you-go usage billing, quick to spin up for validation; typical 72-96h POC (SSO + 10k SCIM + light gen traffic) commonly under $2.5k. Dedicated: reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and latency SLAs; for 8xGPU sizing to support 200 TPS bursts expect a committed range of ~$80k-$150k/month depending on model family and quantization. One-time POC support (eng + security) can be covered by pilot credits or listed as a professional services line item in the SOW."
poc_bot: ticket #POC-8401 created  owners: rami_se (integration), joel_eng (infra), tara_sec (security). Link: https://redwood.internal/poc/POC-8401
ana_sales: Sending initial ask to Cerulean now (IdP metadata, legal POC, 100-user CSV, confirmation on nightly delta window). Keep updates in this thread and flag blockers. :thumbsup:
